headline: SKYWARD's storm now moves
lede: The never-dry ladder found SKYWARD the weakest title on the shelf — its thunderhead had stood at the same spot since rung 2. It doesn't any more: the cell sweeps a slow seeded ellipse while the THUNDERPASS gates stay fixed, so the line you memorised is never quite the line you fly.

notes.text: stormPos(t) is the one answer the sim, HUD and paint all read: gusts, core downdraft, rain shaft, cloud deck and the lightning anchor ride the drifting cell (~140 s east/west, ~190 s north/south, phase per seed).
Amplitude was fixed by law, not taste: an hour-long clock sweep pins that the centre stays offshore, never nears a course, and never greets the pass start deeper than s 0.35.

The old core-sink pin held the plane for exactly 1 s at a hard-coded anchor — inside the gust bob it was a noise read. Re-anchored on stormPos and widened to 3 s, it now measures the pull instead of the weather's jitter.
skywardcheck 52/52 with 13/13 mutants caught (3 new: frozen drift, lying clouds, inland wander); skywardplay watched the cell drift 38 m in 18 s of live sim time on the browser lane.
